lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Register's archived, shredder room is a cupboard again, and the clerk is in on Thursdays.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Sit with her. Four years of drafting behind her, and she can teach a person to read a room in about an hour. It took me two years and I am still not sure I can.

lines.speaker: annex_staffer
lines.text: Reform office. Nine of us, four years, and the number of tabled amendments is now two.
